console_unlock_stay_signed_in_off_a11y: Screen reader: the switch and its state.
console_unlock_stay_signed_in_on_a11y: Screen reader: the switch and its state.

console_ring_slot_empty_edit: Under the ring editor on an empty slot. {button} is the confirm button's name on the attached controller.

console_ring_picker_current: Value beside the action this slot holds now, in the action picker.
console_ring_reset_toast: Toast after the ring is reset to the default.

console_hint_lift: Hint-bar verb in the ring editor: pick a button up to move it.

console_hint_toggle: Hint-bar verb: switch the focused row on or off.
console_hint_page: Hint-bar label for the left/right arrows: scroll a page.

console_shortcut_hint_choose_key: Hint-bar verb in the shortcut editor.
console_shortcut_hint_adjust: Hint-bar label for left/right on a modifier row: left is off, right is on.
console_shortcut_section: Section header over the shortcut editor's name and key rows.
console_shortcut_key_choose: Placeholder value of the Key row while no key is picked.
console_shortcut_modifier_on: Value of a modifier row (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win): held with the key.
console_shortcut_modifier_off: Value of a modifier row (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win): not held.
console_shortcut_saved: Toast after a shortcut is saved.
console_shortcut_removed: Toast after a shortcut is removed.

console_ring_touch_short_pointer: Short word on a ring disc: Touch mode is Direct pointer. Very little space.

console_resolution_type_hint: Second line under Resolution on the console. {button}: the name of the controller button that opens the field, filled from the attached controller.
console_resolution_width_entry: Title of the console's number field while a width is typed.
console_resolution_height_entry: Title of the console's number field while a height is typed.
console_resolution_typing_height: Resolution row while the height is typed. {width}: the width typed a step earlier, in pixels.
